name: explain-branch
description: Analyse the current Git branch and produce a narrated explainer video of what changed, how it works, and how it fits the wider application.

interface.shortDescription: Turn the current Git branch into a narrated code walkthrough video.
interface.longDescription: Explains the current branch relative to a resolved base: what changed, how the changed code works, and how it fits the wider application, rendered as an MP4 with synchronized voice narration.
